programme.title: Alive or Preferably Dead
programme.desc: Twee broers, Monty en Ted, erven 300.000 dollar als ze zes maanden samenwonen.

programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 25, 26, 27
programme.desc: De Wild West-avonturen van Ben Cartwright en zijn zoons terwijl ze hun ranch in Nevada runnen en verdedigen terwijl ze de omringende gemeenschap helpen.

programme.title: Savage Pampas
programme.desc: In de late jaren 1800 probeert een legerkapitein de open vlaktes van Argentinië, die worden beheerst door indianen en bandieten, te temmen. Om hem daarbij te helpen haalt de kapitein een groep vrouwen binnen om zijn soldaten tevreden te houden.

programme.title: Last of the Renegades
programme.desc: Wanneer kolonisten Assiniboin-gebied binnendringen, dreigt oorlog. Winnetou, Old Shatterhand en Lord Castlepool proberen de vrede te bewaren, maar de corrupte oliemagnaat Bud Forrester heeft andere plannen. Door aanvallen te ensceneren en de Indianen de schuld te geven, wil hij hun olierijke land bemachtigen.

programme.title: Gunfighters Die Harder
programme.desc: Criminele bankiers plannen een verzekeringsfraude en huren een Mexicaanse bende in om het goud van de bank te stelen, maar ze betalen ook Lasky's bende om de Mexicanen te doden.

programme.title: Iron Brothers
programme.desc: Abel en Henry Iron, twee pelsjagers in de Rocky Mountains, raken verstrikt in een tragische misverstand met de Shoshone-indianen. Nadat Abel per ongeluk een indiaan doodt, moeten de broers vluchten de bergen in, achtervolgd door de woeste krijgers. Zal de band van broederschap sterk genoeg zijn om hen te redden?

programme.title: Texas, Adios
programme.desc: Burt Sullivan verlaat zijn baan als sheriff om in Mexico wraak te zoeken op Cisco, de moordenaar van zijn vader. In een angstig dorp ontdekt hij een schokkend geheim en werkt hij samen met de bewoners om Cisco te stoppen en gerechtigheid te brengen.

programme.title: Neath the Arizona Skies
programme.desc: Een cowboy begeleidt een klein meisje, wiens moeder haar de erfgenaam maakte van een te gelde gemaakt oliebedrijf, en moet haar beschermen tegen een outlaw terwijl ze op zoek gaan naar de vader van het meisje.

programme.title: Two Brothers in Trinity
programme.desc: Na het erven van een stuk land in een stoffige plaats genaamd Trinity, komen de antagonistische halfbroers, Lester en Jesse, weer bij elkaar om verschillende ambities na te streven. Zullen ze ooit hun dromen waarmaken?

programme.title: Black Jack
programme.desc: Na een bankroof in het Wilde Westen verzamelt een bende zich rond leider Jack Murphy. Wanneer Skinner, Reb, Mathias en de broers Bill en Gordon ontdekken dat Jack de buit voor zichzelf wil houden, slaan ze de handen ineen om hem te verraden en nemen al snel actie.

programme.title: Django, Prepare a Coffin
programme.desc: Een revolverheld vormt een bende van "overleden" executieslachtoffers om wraak te nemen op de politicus en outlaw die zijn vrouw heeft vermoord.

programme.title: Brother Outlaw
programme.desc: Een man wordt valselijk beschuldigd van een bankoverval, waardoor zijn broer hem uit de gevangenis wil breken.

programme.title: Showdown At Williams Creek
programme.desc: Een Britse soldaat besluit naar de Amerikaanse grens te verhuizen en een nieuw leven te beginnen. Hij vindt de grens zwaar en worstelt met het klimaat, dieven en oplichters. Hij wordt beschuldigd van moord en berecht.

programme.title: And Now... Make Your Peace with God
programme.desc: Twee mannen reizen naar Denver City om persoonlijke rekeningen te vereffenen: de een zoekt de moordenaar van zijn vader, de ander een vriend die zijn goud stal. Ze worden vergezeld door een mysterieuze scherpschutter. Samen begint een gevaarlijke jacht vol spanning en geheimen.

programme.title: The Oil Prince
programme.desc: De gewetenloze Olieprins verkoopt een bank niet-bestaande oliebronnen en stuurt kolonisten via een omweg om zijn bedrog te verbergen. Zijn plan lijkt waterdicht, totdat Winnetou en zijn bloedbroeder Old Surehand zijn plannen doorkruisen. De meedogenloze zakenman krijgt onverwacht sterke tegenstanders.

programme.title: Boot Hill
programme.desc: Slachtoffers van de onderdrukkende stadsbaas Honey krijgen hulp aangeboden door een ongewone alliantie van schutters en circusartiesten.

programme.title: Stagecoach (1939)
programme.desc: Een groep mensen die met een postkoets reist, wordt bemoeilijkt door de dreiging van Geronimo en leert daarbij iets over elkaar.

programme.title: Death on High Mountain
programme.desc: Wanneer een overval mislukt, raken twee jonge mannen verstrikt in de nasleep. Ze komen lijnrecht tegenover een bende Mexicaanse bandieten en een corrupte zakenman te staan, die koste wat kost de buit terug willen. Wat begint als toeval verandert al snel in een strijd om overleving en gerechtigheid.

programme.title: Garden Of Evil
programme.desc: Drie Amerikanen op weg naar Californië stranden in een Mexicaans dorp en krijgen een aanbod: een vrouw helpen haar man te redden uit een ingestorte goudmijn. In de gevaarlijke bergen twijfelen ze tussen hebzucht, overleving en hun ware intenties.

programme.title: The Black Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Twee zwarte Kopgeldjagers komen aan in een stadje in het Westen op zoek naar een outlaw. Ze ontdekken dat er geen sheriff is en nemen die rol over, tot ongenoegen van de witte bevolking. Ze veroorzaken chaos, achtervolgen vrouwen en jagen op geld, terwijl ze wachten op het moment om hun man te vangen.

programme.title: Shango
programme.desc: Shango is een Texas Ranger die het moet opnemen tegen een voormalige Confederatie officier en zijn bende misdadigers die een lokale grensstad terroriseren op zoek naar goud.

programme.title: Django the Bastard
programme.desc: Een mysterieuze vreemdeling duikt op om wraak te nemen op voormalige Zuidelijke officieren die tijdens de Amerikaanse Burgeroorlog hun eigen eenheid verraadden, wat leidde tot een bloedige massaslachting. Zijn komst zaait angst terwijl hij hen één voor één confronteert met hun verleden.

programme.title: Day After Tomorrow
programme.desc: Premiejager Stan Ross komt naar de stad na een bankroof en krijgt van burgemeester Jefferson de opdracht de Mexicaanse bandieten te vangen. Maar in de bergen onthult bendeleider Espartero dat zijn mannen onschuldig zijn en zelfs met Jefferson samenwerkten. Stan ontdekt dat de ware macht en dreiging misschien in de stad zelf schuilen.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: Kapitein Tom Harvey, een undercover legeragent, onderzoekt de diefstal van goudzendingen en neemt een baan als adjunct-sheriff in een stad die geteisterd wordt door een spook. Het spook zou een verkeerd veroordeelde gokker zijn, die voor de diefstallen werd opgehangen. Harvey ontdekt het mysterie achter het spook.

programme.title: Yellow Hair and the Fortress of Gold
programme.desc: De vurige blonde halfbloed Yellow Hair en haar gemakkelijke sidekick de Pecos Kid zitten achter een fortuin aan Mayagoud aan.

programme.title: Bad Man's River
programme.desc: Overvaller Roy King verliest zijn vrouw, Alicia, aan de revolutionaire Montero. Ondanks hun rivaliteit werken ze samen in een poging de Mexicaanse regering een miljoen dollar afhandig te maken.

programme.title: For a Book of Dollars
programme.desc: Een premiejager genaamd Amen wordt ingehuurd door een groep nonnen om gestolen geld terug te halen. De nonnen zijn eigenlijk vrouwelijke desperado’s in vermomming die de buit willen terugvinden, geroofd door de outlaw Catapult en zijn bende.

programme.title: A Bullet for the General
programme.desc: Een bende Mexicaanse wapensmokkelaars in dienst van een revolutionaire generaal nemen een Amerikaan op in hun bende, zonder te weten wat zijn bedoelingen zijn.

programme.title: Die blutigen Geier von Alaska
programme.desc: Alaska tijdens de goudkoorts: Bontjager Don Rutland wordt onterecht beschuldigd van roof en moord. Terwijl hij vecht om te overleven, wordt hij bedreigd door rovers en de meedogenloze natuur. Met adembenemende decors, spannende actie en een meeslepende soundtrack biedt deze avonturenfilm pure sensatie.

programme.title: Treasure of Silver Lake
programme.desc: Een postkoets wordt overvallen door de bende van kolonel Brinkley, die een schatkaart zoekt. Fred Engel wil de moord op zijn vader wreken en schakelt Old Shatterhand en Winnetou in. Samen gaan ze op zoek naar de tweede helft van de kaart, terwijl de bende hen op de hielen zit.

programme.title: The Red Pony
programme.desc: Een ranchjongen krijgt een veulen cadeau en groeit op om van hem te houden, maar het veulen ontsnapt, met tragische gevolgen.

programme.title: Thunder at the Border
programme.desc: Winnetou en zijn zus Nscho-chi vluchten voor de bende van de Silers en vinden hulp bij pelsjagers onder leiding van Old Firehand. In Miramonte dreigt een aanval om een gevangengenomen bendelid te bevrijden. Terwijl Winnetou en Old Firehand helpen de stad te verdedigen, komt ook een verrassend familiegeheim aan het licht.

programme.title: $100,000 for Ringo
programme.desc: Lee Barton komt aan in Rainbow Valley, waar men hem verwart met Ward Cluster, een man die stierf in de burgeroorlog. Bartons leven raakt verstrengeld met lokale conflicten, een moordzuchtige baas en een zoekgeraakte schat. Samen met een sheriff zoekt hij gerechtigheid en een toekomst met Ward’s zoon Sean.

programme.title: Custer of the West
programme.desc: George Armstrong Custer's liefde voor de heroïsche tradities van de Calvarie en zijn afkeer van de komst van de industrialisatie leidt hem naar zijn lot bij de Little Big Horn.

programme.title: Shoot the Living and Pray for the Dead
programme.desc: Nadat Dan Hogan en zijn bende een bank hebben overvallen, huren ze een mysterieuze man in om hen over de Mexicaanse grens te leiden in ruil voor de helft van de buit.

programme.title: Apache Fury
programme.desc: Een rechter herkent tijdens een Apache-aanval een man die hij ooit onrecht aandeed. Samen met zijn verloofde en andere postkoetsreizigers zoekt hij toevlucht in een afgelegen rustplaats. Daar, omsingeld door dreiging van buiten én spanningen van binnen, wordt hij geconfronteerd met schuld, gevaar en onvermijdelijke keuzes.

programme.title: The Ruthless Four
programme.desc: In Nevada vinden goudzoeker Sam Cooper en zijn partner goud. Maar Sam's hebzuchtige partner begint te schieten op Sam die zijn toevlucht zoekt in de goudmijn.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: In 1876, Capt. Phillip Donlin hoort dat zijn vrouw, Celie, een affaire heeft met luitenant Haywood. Gebroken door de verraad vertrekt hij op een missie om generaal Custer te waarschuwen voor een grote Sioux-aanval bij Little Big Horn. Spanningen ontstaan tussen de troepen als Donlin zijn orders negeert om een heldhaftige waarschuwing te geven.

programme.title: Twice a Judas
programme.desc: Luke Barrett ontwaakt in de woestijn met geheugenverlies en een geweer met 'Dingus'. In de saloon ontmoet hij een mysterieuze vreemdeling die zijn naam kent. Langzaam ontdekt Luke dat hij met zijn partner is ingehuurd om zijn broer Victor te doden. Terwijl herinneringen terugkomen, wachten hem grote keuzes.

programme.title: Gunman of Ave Maria
programme.desc: Mann is een schutter die van een jeugdvriend te horen krijgt dat zijn vader jaren eerder is vermoord door zijn moeder en haar minnaar.

programme.title: My Name Is Shanghai Joe
programme.desc: Een Chinese immigrant, net aangekomen in Amerika, vecht om Mexicaanse slaven te bevrijden van hun wrede meester.

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: Golden Fries, a food truck venture founded by Jesse Teasdale and his wife, has become a popular spot at Bluesfest Ottawa. The truck, which started as a one-woman operation, quickly gained traction and now sees massive crowds, even requiring early gate openings for events like the Foo Fighters' performance. The menu highlights a classic poutine, made with fresh-cut fries, squeaky cheese curds, and rich gravy, as its top-selling item. The video captures various attendees raving about the quality and taste of the food, emphasizing the truck's commitment to using local, high-quality ingredients. Additionally, the video showcases the preparation and dedication that goes into running the truck, from early morning setups to handling large orders for bands and their crews. The narrative underscores the community spirit and the joy of sharing delicious food at live events.

programme.title: Dinner in Paris
programme.desc: Romain Avril explores the classics that define Parisian dining, from perfectly seasoned steak tartare and creamy French veal stew to a silky crème brûlée, celebrating the simple techniques and rich traditions behind three beloved French favourites.

programme.title: Flour Power
programme.desc: High tea requires royal desserts! Host Jessica McGovern gives us the lowdown on some sophisticated sweets to pair with a warm cup of tea.

programme.title: VEGANnotvegan
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki go head-to-head with a seafood classic! Maddie makes scallops and Parmesan risotto, while Kiki creates a plant-based version with king oyster “scallops” and bulgur risotto. Two sisters, two delicious takes.

programme.title: VEGANnotvegan
programme.desc: Maddy and Kikki put their own spin on a pan-seared favorite, with juicy chicken and deeply savory mushrooms sizzling away in two hearty takes on the dish. Golden seared edges, rich sauces and plenty of flavor make this a satisfying showdown.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Host Pailin Chongchitnant introduces us to some of her favourite and simple Thai dishes like Hot and Sour Soup and a decadent Beef Panang Curry.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Argentinian host, Natalia Machado, exquisitely prepares delicious dishes from Argentina including lamb two different ways.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Cheerful host Vijaya Selvaraju shows us just how easy Indian dishes can be incorporated into everyday meals.

programme.title: Global Street Eats
programme.desc: Chef Dev shares straightforward recipes for street foods that have gained popularity around the world. including Dan Dan Noodles from China. Doner Kebab from Turkey. and Samosas from India.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Go-to Indian menu item Lamb Rogan Josh is one thing, but Lamb Sweetbreads Rogan Josh with Aloo Gobi Foam? That's a CombiNATION Plates thing! Craig Wong is at it again in this USA + India episode. After India, Chef moves on to the USA to answer the question, 'is everything better battered and fried?' with his Country Fried Torchon of Foie Gras. The common ingredient for these two distant nations is lobster, and really, who doesn't love it? For the US, it's Lobster with Cajun Spice Grits and Pickled Okra, and for India, check out Lobster Curry with Coconut Milk. The finale features Catfish like you've never seen it. Cooked Tandoori style and served with Collard Greens Paneer and Peach Bhaji, it's a one-of-a-kind CombiNATION sensation!

programme.title: Global Veggies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 India, Belgium, Italy, China
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by India - Bhindi Masala-Style Nopales, Belgium - Belgian Plantain Waffles, Italy - Almond Crusted Portobellos, and China - Sichuan Artichoke Stir Fry!

programme.title: Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: Indian meals are the epitome of a full family dinner. Host Spencer Watts uses bold flavours to make classic Butter Chicken and refreshing Mango Lassi.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Robert Jewell explores recipes using two very different ingredients that start with the letter "O," oats and okra. For his first dish, Robert uses okra in a classic cornmeal cake recipe, but bumps up the flavour factor with spicy jalapenos. Robert balances the heat of the jalapeno with a tart green tomato and crunchy red onion salsa. In his next recipe, Robert keeps the heat, but switches up his recipes for a curry-spiced oat pancake. This Indian inspired dish needs something to cool it down and Robert knows exactly what that is - sweet, silky applesauce! He's up for the challenge when it comes to combining okra and oats into one dish, and the results are tasty!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Ever crave a delicious Indian feast? Host Vijaya Selvaraju cooks up Indian classics for a delightful family meal.

programme.title: Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: Craving Vegan by Sam Turnbull! Follow along as Shahir prepares vegan white lasagna, jackfruit pulled pork, tofu tikka masala, and much more!

programme.title: Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: It's Tandoori Take-Out night as host Spencer Watts prepares five quick and easy Indian dishes that take little time, but are big in flavour.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna; sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 DIY your Indian Food
programme.desc: Cheerful host Vijaya Selvaraju shows us how to DIY some of the important staples of Indian cuisine.

programme.title: Global Street Eats
programme.desc: Chef Dev prepares some of his favorite South Asian street foods, including Nihari Stew from Pakistan, Momo Dumplings from Nepal, and sweet Jalebi from India.

programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 Portugal, Argentina, India, Japan

Poppy Sandler innovates with Indian inspiration - carrot cake becomes Carrot Rostis, thin pancakes dished out with perfectly poached eggs and a homemade savoury raisin jam. Tiera Singh returns to the Rock and makes Jerk Crab Salad Mango Rolls. Jazzing up the crab meat with a blend of Jamaican jerk and autumn spices, she finishes the dish by wrapping the mixture in layers of smooth avocado slices and juicy mango.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The 300"
programme.desc: An ultra rare 1957 Mercedes Benz 300 SL Roadster is resto-modded using a modern Mercedes Benz SLK 230 as a donor vehicle.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Reveal"
programme.desc: At Santa Pod raceway, engineer and driver Jon Webster reveals the final Flying Kestrel to Joel and Nigel McNully, he gives them a tour around the finished car and shows them all the changes he has made, all to hopefully get a land speed record.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "Ready to race"

programme.title: Desert Racers S1 - "Oil and Uncertainty"

programme.title: Desert Racers S1 - "Collision Course"
programme.desc: Jimmy’s final practice sessions lead to breakdowns and panic, while Bruce races to adapt his truck mid-race.

programme.title: Close Proximity S1 - "Long Break"

programme.desc: Alyssa’s car is stolen. Mark gives Alyssa a lesson about car quality and Goldberg arrives to pick up his car.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S6 - "A Fly in the Ointment"

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S6 - "Will Gets Grumpy"

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S1 - "1963 Corvette Z06"

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1 - "Las Vegas"

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Bhavnagar: Land of Surprises"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 Bhavnagar: Land of Surprises

Between stays at all the luxury boutique resorts, a common trend starts to appear, and that is the island’s cuisine.

programme.title: Ainsley's Market Menu S1 - "Hobart"

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "New York"
programme.desc: Rapper Shiniqua, aka Pretty Little Monster, juggles motherhood while trying to avoid the trappings of Instagram fame. Her passion is writing rap lyrics and always tries to keep it real.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Donsol, Philippines"
programme.desc: Disaster and triumph set this show apart. The brothers start out with a near death boat disaster in the southern Philippine Sea but bounce back and end up attaining their goal of reaching Donsol village, the whale shark capitol of the world.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Ryozenji Temple Shikoku, Japan"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Ryozenji Temple Shikoku, Japan
programme.desc: In this episode the brothers shun the more famous areas, Tokyo and Kyoto, and head to the isolated, ancient island of Shikoku. Their route is the ancient 88 Temple Zen pilgrimage circuit.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Cape Breton Island, Canada"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Cape Breton Island, Canada
programme.desc: By pick-up truck, the brothers route is the culturally and geographically rich island of Cape Breton and the Cabot Trail. Lobster fishing, hooking, moose sightings, Bingo, Scottish ceilidhs, Mi'kmaq drum session, it's all happening in this episode.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S4 - "Coromandel"
programme.desc: Piri is freediving with Hahei instructor Josh, training with Mercury Bay High Schools’ girls 1st XV, and checking out a Māori owned mussel farm.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S4 - "Wellsford"
programme.desc: Piri goes fishing with the Wright Brothers. He tries to catch some mud crabs on his own, then delivers the kai to a local Kaumatua.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S4 - "Far North"
programme.desc: Piri spends the day touring from 90mile beach to Cape Reinga.Then he helps run a coaching session at a local kura with Black Fern legend Cheryl Waaka.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Rwanda…Gorillas"
programme.desc: Bill tracks through never ending mud, heavy vegetation and steep mountains, to come face-to-face with our mighty cousins. He also traces the life, and finds the remnants, of the camp of one of his idols - Diane Fossey.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Botswana"
programme.desc: Botswana is a wildlife lover’s dream with massive herds of elephants, immense pods of hippos and some of the largest prides of lions anywhere. It’s also the home of Victoria Falls…the largest falls in the world.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "New Zealand & Australia"
programme.desc: Bill has always been fascinated with the Americas Cup yacht racing – it’s as intense as the name implies. But the big adventure is riding in, and then flying, a Soviet Mig Jet doing stunts and mind numbing close fly-bys.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Tallinn"
programme.desc: Josh Yozura goes off the beaten path in Tallinn for some local urban exploring in an old Soviet theatre and a prison hidden underneath the ice of a quarry lake.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Marrakech"
programme.desc: Cody is in Marrakech, Morocco, for a local exploring adventure on BMX-bikes through an old medina, along graffiti walls, night markets and a forbidden hotel.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Berlin"
programme.desc: Historical Berlin offers Josh two days of adventures and hidden treasures including a former U.S. Spy Station used during the Cold War and an abandoned garage.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S1 - "Chile, Australia and Kenya"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Chile, Australia and Kenya
programme.desc: In this episode of Travels with the Bondi Vet, Chris takes to the streets in the Chilean capital, finds the ultimate island paradise in Australia and pushes himself to the limit in a Kenyan Marathon.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S1 - "Thailand and Australia's Best Secret Beach"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Thailand and Australia's Best Secret Beach
programme.desc: In this episode of Travels with the Bondi Vet, Chris discovers a holiday with a difference in Thailand, reveals Australia’s best secret beach and finds a city that’s stuck in a time warp.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S1 - "Japan and Australia... for dogs!"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Japan and Australia... for dogs!
programme.desc: This week on Travels with the Bondi Vet, Chris takes part in Japan’s quirkiest festival and road tests Australia’s best holiday... for dogs. Chris embarks on an Aussie outback experience with a bird’s eye view of one of Australia’s most breathtaking sights!

programme.title: Travel with a Goat S1 - "Donkey"
programme.desc: Two foodies travel through Sicily with an animal. Will they decide to have the animal slaughtered after spending three days together with it?

programme.title: Travel with a Goat S1 - "Pig"
programme.desc: Two foodies travel through Thailand with an animal. Will they decide to have the animal slaughtered after spending three days together with it?

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5 - "India: Kolkata"
programme.desc: Jonathan explores Kolkata’s Kalighat, studies dancing and divinity, uncovers British East India history, and visits India’s only Chinatown.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5 - "Manipur"
programme.desc: Jonathan explores India’s polo roots in Manipur, meets a women’s polo club, discovers a horse god, and uncovers local martial arts.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S5 - "Thailand"
programme.desc: Jonathan explores Bangkok’s canals, Buddhist sects, a wild zoo, wildlife rescues, amulet markets, and Thai massage.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Banff & Lake Louise"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson goes heli hiking and caving while exploring Canada’s first and most popular National Park and neighboring Lake Louise.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Australia’s Northern Territory"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads down under to explore the Larapinta Trail and Kakadu National Park.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Fiji"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson goes off the beaten path as he hikes from one remote village to the next through Fiji’s mountainous landscape.

programme.title: Car & Country Quest S1 - "Inside Ferrari 2"
programme.desc: Freddie leads an exclusive Ferrari tour, as they explore Ferrari’s design centre, visit its museum, and honour F1 champions. A friendly race in the Ferrari simulator and a scenic drive in new Ferraris close their Italian adventure beautifully.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S2 - "Riding America’s highest altitude and most scenic railways"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 Riding America’s highest altitude and most scenic railways
programme.desc: Breathtaking views await on a historic steam train as the trek reaches its highest altitude while navigating a famously scenic route.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S2 - "Riding America’s longest ferry"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 Riding America’s longest ferry
programme.desc: A first-class railcar carries Michael toward the Grand Canyon before he boards the country's longest ferry ride to bridge the gap to the north.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S2 - "Arriving at America’s most northern train station"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E06 Arriving at America’s most northern train station
programme.desc: A massive ferry voyage finally delivers Michael to Alaska, where he completes the epic journey at the most northern train station.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Mavericks"
programme.desc: Big wave surfing’s elite break routines and converge to ride an unforgettable swell at Mavericks.

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: The son of Sheriff Clay Hartley, of the frontier town Elder, has gotten into bad company and hangs out with an outlaw gang in which, Collins, owner of the Golden Rule Saloon, is the secret head. Sheriff Hartley suspects him, but has been unable to gather the needed evidence. Collins instructs his gang, including young Hartley, to hold up the stagecoach on its return trip from Missionary Flats and take the cargo of gold dust it is carrying. Sheriff Hartley is notified of the planned holdup by one of his deputies who has been spying on Collins, and organizes a posse. A deputy-sheriff is killed in the ensuing gunfight between the lawmen and the outlaws, but Deputy Joe Larkin, pursues and captures Clay Hartley Jr. The latter is quickly tried and convicted of the killing of the deputy, and sentenced to be hung. Sheriff Hartley has only a few hours to prove his son was not the killer. He enlists the aid of Collins' step-daughter, Joan, who is in love with Hartley's son.

programme.title: Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: Icon of early talking pictures, Harry Carey (Red River), portrays the rugged Trigger Carson, a noble cowboy who infiltrates an outlaw gang in order to expose their rackets. Ordered to kidnap a young girl, his identity is revealed and he is forced to fight his way out of the gang and back to safety. Already 56 by the time he signed on to do this and a series of Westerns for Berke Productions, the stately Carrey (who netted an Oscar nomination four years later) was widely lauded at the time for adding a great deal of maturity and respectability due to his undeniable presence and strong performances.

programme.title: Ghost Town Gold [The Three Mesquiteers]
programme.desc: CAVALIERS OF THE CACTUS COUNTRY--ALWAYS READY FOR A FIGHT OR A FROLICK! The second entry in what would grow into a wildly popular series of Western Three Mesquiteers B-Movies produced by Republic Pictures, Ghost Town Gold tracks the titular trio as they attempt to recover the gold stolen by a gang in its effort to ruin the bank/mayor who ordered them to leave town. Frequent John Wayne collaborator Joseph Kane adds his signature directorial panache to this rousing shoot-em-up, setting the tone for a film series that was so rampantly successful, it spawned 50 sequels and a host of imitators from rival studios.

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: Bulldog Courage
programme.desc: Tim McCoy, one of the unsung heroes of 1930s western pictures, stars in a dual role. First, hes Slim Braddock, a miner who turns to robbing stagecoaches after being swindled by a banker. When Slim is murdered, his son Tim, also played by McCoy, seeks vengeance. Directed by B-movie legend Sam Newfield for Excelsior Pictures, this film is a showcase for McCoy, who appeared in more than 90 movies and in 1960 earned a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame!

programme.title: Red Ryder: Roll, Thunder, Roll!
programme.desc: Red Ryder finds two silver conchas, the trademark of bandit El Conejo, at a raided ranch. He reports the raid to Marshal Bill Faugh but tells him that he suspects that El Conejo, a Robin Hood type character, is being framed.

programme.title: Springtime in the Sierras
programme.desc: Ads for this Roy Rogers classic roared HEAD FOR THE MUSICAL HILLS...ROY IS GUNNIN' FOR THRILLS! And thrills are what you'll get when you watch this fun, action packed B-Western from Republic Pictures. There's some great comic relief from Andy Devine and Chester Conklin, two of Hollywood's all-time greats. This old-fashioned shoot-'em-up was directed by William Witney, who would go on to direct many of television's top western sagas, including Bonanza, Wagon Train, and The Wild, Wild West.

programme.title: Leather Burners
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) gets the call when a herd of rustled cattle mysteriously disappear. Andy Clyde, Victor Jory and George Reeves (televisions Superman!) also star in this, the 42nd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy features. If you look closely, you might even notice Robert Mitchum in an uncredited role!

programme.title: In Old Cheyenne
programme.desc: Roy Rogers plays a newspaper reporter sent to Cheyenne to investigate a reputed troublemaker. While on the scene, he discovers who the real bad guys are, and sets out to right some wrongs. Also starring Roy's usual sidekick George 'Gabby' Hayes, plus Joan Woodbury, and George Rosener. This Republic Pictures western was helmed by director Joseph Kane (The Undersea Kingdom, Dakota) and features two musical numbers: 'Bonita' and 'Linda Flor'.

programme.title: Yodelin' Kid from Pine Ridge
programme.desc: Cowboy icon Gene Autry is framed for murder in this tale of warring cattlemen and turpentiners. The music driven western from director Joseph Kane (Flame of Barbary Coast) includes such familiar faces as Smiley Burnette, Charles Middleton, and Betty Bronson. In between gunshots you'll hear plenty of traditional cowboy songs, including She'll Be Coming 'Round The Mountain, and Red River Valley, plus Gene's version of Sing Me a Song of the Saddle.

programme.title: Young Buffalo Bill
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars in this highly fictionalized account of Bill Cody's life from director Joseph Kane (Dakota, Flame of Barbary Coast). What it lacks in accuracy is made up for with adventure, as well as and some of Roy's great cowboy songs, including 'Blow Breeze Blow', and 'Rollin' Down to Santa Fe'. Other stars include George 'Gabby' Hayes, Chief Thundercloud, and the lovely Pauline Moore (Young Mr. Lincoln, Charlie Chan at Treasure Island)

programme.title: Frontier Justice
programme.desc: Hoot Gibson is back! But he never imagined he'd find his father in an insane asylum and his cattle ranch overrun with sheep! Worst of all, Roger Williams stars as the diabolical James WIlton, a rival who isn't above murder. For trivia buffs: Director Robert F. McGowan was the man behind several of the classic Our Gang comedies...

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: Daniel Boone
programme.desc: In 1775, Daniel Boone (George O'Brien) leads thirty colonial families to Kentucky where they face the threats of Native American marauders led by rebel Simon Girty (John Carradine). That's just the beginning, for there are even more dangers and clashes ahead for Boone and his party. With a cast that includes Ralph Forbes, Heather Angel, and lovable child star Dickie Jones, director David Howard takes us through one of the most exciting periods in American history!

programme.title: Cry Blood Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: An Apache brave seeks vengeance on a band of sadistic gold hunters in this bloody drive-in western. Pitcalin (Jody McRae) leads the marauders who wipe out an Apache camp when they discover gold, only to watch their violent deeds lead to their own demise. Featuring a superb cast that also includes Dan Kemp, Robert Tessier, and Joel McRae, this coldblooded western tale was directed by character actor and filmmaker Jack Starrett (Cleopatra Jones, The Losers).

programme.title: Tulsa
programme.desc: Susan Hayward stars in this dramatic tale of the Oklahoma oil boom. She plays Cherokee Lansing, a determined young woman out to protect her father's honor after he's killed by men from a competing oil company. With a cast that includes Robert Preston, Ed Begley, and Pedro Armendariz, this engaging picture from producer Walter Wanger (Cleopatra, I Want to Live!) was nominated for an Academy Award in the Special Effects category. Also, listen for veteran character actor Chill Wills as the narrator!

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover US Marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is investigating a rash of robberies by a character known as The Polka Dot Bandit in this B-movie gem. Along the way, Carruthers finds himself in more trouble than he'd ever expected! Written and directed by Robert N. Bradbury, the film features George Gabby Hayes, Eleanor Hunt, and many other favorites of the era. Wayne was only 27 at the time of Blue Steel, but was well on his way to becoming The Duke.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: He likes his whiskey hard... His women soft... And his west all to himself! Inspired by Shakespeares The Taming of the Shrew (1594), John Wayne (The Searchers, Stagecoach), Maureen OHara (Miracle on 34th Street, The Parent Trap), and Patrick Wayne (The Searchers, The Alamo) star in this western comedy directed by Andrew V. McLaglen (Gunsmoke, The Wild Geese). George Washington McLintock (John Wayne) is the wealthiest man in his territory who utilizes his power and influence to maintain order between farmers, ranchers, Indians, corrupt government officials, and his own family! McLintock is McNificent!

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Billy the Kid, Pat Garrett, and Doc Holliday ride again in Howard Hughes' epic 1943 western, but the character you'll remember most is sultry country vixen Rio McDonald. Hughes' nationwide search for an actress to play Rio resulted in the film debut of Jane Russell, whose natural assets were allegedly helped by a special bra designed by Hughes. When The Outlaw finally received a nationwide release in 1946, its success vindicated Hughes and made Russell a star. As for Hughes' infamous bra, Russell said in her 1988 memoir, I never wore it, and he never knew.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: A love story and a search for gold in the Valley of Death! Dubbed simple, powerful and dramatic by the New York Times on the date of its release, Death Valley is indeed an elegant depiction of love and deception in the American desert during the Gold Rush. In what was to be the final film of famed silent film director Paul Powell (Polyanna), a cast of mostly unknown actors produces uniformly excellent work. Lyrical and graceful, Powells film spins the tale of a young boy who finds love and gold, only to have it stolen from him.

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: The son of Sheriff Clay Hartley, of the frontier town Elder, has gotten into bad company and hangs out with an outlaw gang in which, Collins, owner of the Golden Rule Saloon, is the secret head. Sheriff Hartley suspects him, but has been unable to gather the needed evidence. Collins instructs his gang, including young Hartley, to hold up the stagecoach on its return trip from Missionary Flats and take the cargo of gold dust it is carrying. Sheriff Hartley is notified of the planned holdup by one of his deputies who has been spying on Collins, and organizes a posse. A deputy-sheriff is killed in the ensuing gunfight between the lawmen and the outlaws, but Deputy Joe Larkin, pursues and captures Clay Hartley Jr. The latter is quickly tried and convicted of the killing of the deputy, and sentenced to be hung. Sheriff Hartley has only a few hours to prove his son was not the killer. He enlists the aid of Collins' step-daughter, Joan, who is in love with Hartley's son.

programme.title: Call of the Forest
programme.desc: There's plenty of drama in this tale of lost gold mines, gallant stallions, and fuzzy bears. Starring Ken Curtis, Robert Lowery, and Chief Thundercloud, this charming little film is highlighted by Karl Struss' stunning photography

programme.title: Stagecoach to Denver
programme.desc: Ride the outlaws' highway! Allan Rocky Lane stars as Red Ryder, shootin' and fightin' his way to justice in this old slugfest from Republic Pictures. This time he's a stagecoach driver battling a crooked land commissioner and his cohorts, including a sheriff on the take. Robert Blake costars as Little Beaver!

programme.title: Hit the Saddle
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers get involved when a local sheriff is killed in this B-western from Republic Pictures. The trouble starts when a villainous rancher (J.P. McGowan) plots to steal some government protected horses. Bob Livingstone, Max Terhune, and Ray Corrigan star as the gallant Mesquiteers, while a young Rita Hayworth (Gilda, The Lady From Shanghai) appears as a sexy saloon singer who turns a Mesquiteer's head.

programme.title: Young Bill Hickock
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars as the title character in this actionpacked feature from Republic Pictures. Starring Sally Payne as Calamity Jane, and Rogerss ongoing sidekick George Gabby Hayes, this twofisted saga relives some of Americas most colorful days, and also has time for a few musical numbers, including Up and Down the Prairie, and When the Shadows Fall Across the Rockies.

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Roy Rogers goes to jail after hes wrongly accused of killing Gabby Hayes horse in this action packed yarn from Republic Pictures. All of the old jokes about cowboys kissing their horse may have started with this very movie, as it focuses on Roys loving relationship with Trigger, the greatest horse in all of Hollywood. The film also features Roys beloved Dale Evans, plus, adding some country swing to the musical numbers is Roys favorite backing band, the Sons of the Pioneers! Songs include Ole Faithful, Long, Long Ago and Livin Western Style.

programme.title: Boots and Saddles
programme.desc: When a young Englishman inherits a ranch, none other than Gene Autry takes up the challenge of turning the Brit into a real westerner. He convinces the Brit to use the ranch to raise horses, but things quickly grow complicated. Look for the usual cast of characters from Republic Pictures, including Smiley Burnette (as the irresistible Frog Millhouse!). Songs include Take Me Back To My Boots and Saddle, and Ridin the Range.

programme.title: Arizona Bound
programme.desc: The Rough Riders are called upon to help save a stagecoach line. From 1941, starring Buck Jones and Tim McCoy, plus Horace Murphy and Luana Walters. Directed by Spencer Bennett.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).

programme.title: Kentucky Rifle
programme.desc: His Wits, Weapons and Women, Turned Defeat Into Victory! A man brings a wagonload of Kentucky rifles through Indian Territory. Unfortunately the Indians realize what he has and offer the travelers an ultimatum: the rifles or their lives! Starring Lance Fuller, Sterling Holloway, Henry Hull, Chill Wills, Cathy Downs, and Jeanne Cagney, plus one of the great B-Western heels, I. Stanford Jolley!

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: A big time cast, including Randolph Scott, Buster Crabbe, Barton MacLane, and Harry Carey star in this feature about stampedes, Indian attacks, and plundering thieves! Directed by the esteemed Henry Hathaway (True Grit, Niagara).

programme.title: Way of the West
programme.desc: Government agent Gordon (Hal Taliaferro) goes undercover to investigate an ongoing war between cattlemen and sheepmen. But he soon finds himself framed for murder! This low budget western from the short-lived Empire Pictures is from the golden era of shoot em ups, when audiences knew who the bad guys were, and couldnt wait for the good guys to serve up some just punishment!

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures!

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western. He and George Gabby Hayes strike it rich with a gold mine, only to find their lives complicated by women and crooked officials. Things get even messier when the good guys are framed for murder! Its all action here, particularly since legendary stuntman Yakima Cannut stars as one of the films heavies. Who will win the fight over the gold and the girl? Directed by Robert N. Bradbury for Monogram Pictures. Also starring Barbara Sheldon. (The film was also known as Gold Strike River.)

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Knights of the sage-brush roar across the plains in this western drama from Harry Sherman Productions. Victor Jory ( Papillon, Gone With The Wind), stars as a ranch foreman wrongly arrested for murder. The memorable cast includes Tom Tyler (Stage Coach, Adventures of Captain Marvel), plus Noah Beery Jr (The Rockford Files) and in one of his earliest feature roles, Alan Ladd (The Blue Dahlia, Shane).

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: A young drifter is suspected of murder in this stirring production from writer/director Alan Le May (best known for writing The Searchers). John Drew Barrymore stars as Cooncat, a troubled young man who has to steal to survive. With no friends in West Texas, he falls in with some bad customers who involve him in some terrible crimes. The strong cast includes Chill Wills, Jack Elam, and John Archer, with cinematography by Oscar winner W. Howard Greene.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Randolph Scott plays James Barlow, an agent from Chicago hired to bring the notorious Reno brothers to justice. But wouldnt you know it? The Reno gang includes a beautiful young woman (Mala Powers), who catches Barlows eye. This western from director Tim Whelan (The Thief of Bagdad) features cinematography by two-time Oscar winner Ray Rennahan (Gone With The Wind), while the screenplay was by noted author Horace McCoy (They Shoot Horses, Dont They?). Theres also an all-star cast, including Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Edgar Buchanan, Denver Pyle, and several other shaggy sidewinders!

programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: The end of the Mexican-American War finds a brazen U.S. Calvary captain and his men taking over a Spanish land grant. Albert C. Gannaway (The Badge of Marshall Brennan) directs an all-star cast including Jim Davis (Jock Ewing of Dallas), Arleen Whelan (Young Mr. Lincoln) and Lee Van Cleef (The Good, The Bad, and the Ugly). Also, look for appearances by legendary country & western stars Marty Robbins and Faron Young.

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila O'Conner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Rawhide Rangers
programme.desc: Blackie's gang is creating havoc and the Ranger, Brand Calhoun and his brother go to investigate.

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Ranch
programme.desc: Flagg is relocating flood victims to Gunsmoke Ranch. The Three Mesquiteers know Flagg to be a crook and try to warn them. They ignore the warning and improve the land only to find that it has been condemned for a new dam.

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: Roy Rogers finds himself elected sheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War. But can Roy handle a place under martial law? And can he save Gabby Hayes from being executed? And how many songs will he get to sing? Clear the burrs from your saddle and get ready for a good one, also starring Marjorie Reynolds, plus Sally Payne as Belle Starr, Queen of the Oklahoma Outlaws!

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: What happens when Abraham Lincoln himself comes to New Mexico to discuss a treaty with Native American chief Acoma (Ted de Corsia)? Can the hotbed of emotions be quieted by cavalry Captain Hunt (Lew Ayres)? Or will the Captains superiors insist on provoking with the native tribe? Find out what happens in this fictional tale packed with action from 1951!

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: This Roy Rogers adventure finds Gabby Whitaker (Gabby Hayes) running a ranch for wayward boys. One of the boys uses stolen money to help Gabby pay off his debts, but things unravel when the boys father, a notorious outlaw named King Blaine, is murdered; the rest of the Blaine gang show up at Gabbys looking for the loot! Director Frank McDonald works with a fine cast, including Dale Evans, Lyle Talbot, and of course, Roys beloved horse Trigger.

programme.title: Hands Across The Border
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures western about horse breeders vying for a contract with the U.S. Army. The cast also includes such favorites as Onslow Stevens and Guinn Big Boy Williams, while songs include Hey Hey (It's a Great Day), Dreaming to Music, and The Girl with the High Button Shoes. For movie buffs: The music for the title song, Hands Across the Border, was composed by none other than Hoagy Carmichael!

programme.title: Public Cowboy No. 1
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Smiley Burnette are back, and this time theyre dealing with some very modern thinking rustlers. These new criminals have taken up the latest technologies to outsmart the authorities, including shortwave radios and airplanes! Can Gene and Smiley get em? You bet! Songs include The West Aint What It Used To Be, I Got the HeebieJeebie Blues, and The Defective Detective from Brooklyn. Gene also gets romantic when he sings, I Picked up the Trail when I Found You...

programme.title: Captain Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of his henchmen deliver guns across the border to a corrupt Mexican general who is bent on overtaking the province by force. When Griffin then demands that the general now fulfill his part of the bargain, the general orders him killed, unaware that his lieutenant, Sanchez is in Griffins employ. Rather than killing Griffin, Sanchez shoots the general, and after promoting himself to the post, promises Griffin that he will cross the border in time for April Morning. When O.J. is found murdered, Apache questions Maude, who reveals that O.J. traveled to a Mexican cantina monthly. Apache then rides to the cantina, where he is met by a cavalry patrol led by Sgt. ORourke. Upon learning that the cantina owner has recently been killed, Apache demands that the mans widow, Rosita, take him to Rodriguez, her husbands employer. Rosita then introduces Apache to a Mexican sergeant who allegedly knows where Rodriguez can be found. Unaware that the sergeant is Rodriguez disguised as a soldier, Apache follows him to a church where the priest claims that Rodriguez has claimed sanctuary and is therefore immune to the law.

programme.title: Mohawk
programme.desc: Kurt Neumann (The Fly, Rocketship X-M) directed this bawdy tale of a love that was louder than war drums! With a cast that includes Scott Brady, Rita Gam, and Neville Brand, the story takes place on a remote army post where an artist romances a trio of women, just as a vengeful settler turns the army and the local Iroquois tribe against each other. Film buffs might like to know that the cinematography for this feature is by four-time Oscar nominee Karl Struss, who won an Academy Award in 1929 for his work on Sunrise.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: John Wayne sings! Well, not really. His voice was dubbed here, but as Singin Sandy Saunders hes still able to write the code of justice with a blazing sixgun! Hes a government agent out to help a group of ranchers in their battle with a villain who is tying up local water rights. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Al St. John, Yakima Canutt, and Cecilia Parker, Riders of Destiny was filmed early in Waynes career it was his first for Lone Star but the unmistakable swagger is already in place!

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: Dad Longworth robs a Mexican bank, takes the loot, and leaves his partner Rio to be captured. However, Rio escapes capture and searches for Dad in California.

programme.desc: OUTDOOR & Nature, a weekly program that highlights sports, outdoor activities, and the breathtaking scenery of Cyprus, will introduce you to the great outdoors. Each episode highlights government initiatives, community organisations, and volunteer efforts to preserve Cyprus's natural heritage while examining nature, wildlife, and conservation. Take a trip of inspiration, exploration, and adventure with hosts Panicos Pilalis and Aristo Aristeidou. Listen and get motivated to go on your own outdoor adventure in Cyprus!

programme.title: Hvar (Stari Grad)
programme.desc: The island of Hvar, Croatia’s sunniest spot, is perfect for enjoying a traditional Dalmatian marenda. In the charming town of Stari Grad, restaurateur Damir Čavić welcomed us with a spread of marinated anchovies, octopus salad, pašticada, cod, and vegetables—washed down with a light bevanda.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Calabria
programme.desc: Malini explores Calabria, a hidden gem in Southern Italy. While its coastal towns like Tropea and Scilla boast turquoise seas, Calabria’s true charm lies in its rural interior, where traditions like handmade pasta, cheese, and salami are still alive. She visits ghost villages like Pentedattilo in the Aspromonte mountains and experiences authentic Calabrian culture, food, and hospitality, hosted by Calabria Etnica.

programme.desc: Discover the wonders of southern France as we savor Roman ruins in Nîmes, a papal palace in Avignon, Van Gogh's vivid views in Arles, and the vineyards of the Côtes du Rhône.

programme.title: Concerto - OSN Marc Albrecht E Simone Lamsma Torino
programme.sub-title: Concerto - OSN Marc Albrecht E Simone Lamsma Torino
programme.desc: In this 2022 concert in Turin, Marc Albrecht conducts the Orchestra Sinfonica Nazionale della Rai, with Simone Lamsma as the violin soloist. The programme includes Shostakovich's Violin Concerto No. 1, showcasing Lamsma's technical brilliance and emotional depth, and Franck's Symphony in D minor, celebrated for its rich harmonies and cyclical structure. The performance highlights a powerful blend of passion and precision.

programme.title: Whats On - 4 - Colours of Mediterranean Culture
programme.sub-title: Whats On - 4 - Colours of Mediterranean Culture
programme.desc: From Malta to Greece, Mediterranean arts flourish. Valletta Baroque Festival, Malta International Arts Festival, and Birgu by Candlelight light up the island with music and heritage. Italy’s Cortona on the Move, La Fenice in Piazza San Marco, and Mercantia Festival showcase photography, opera, and street performance. France’s Art Paris and International Garden Festival, Spain’s Revela’t Festival and La Leyenda de Tartessos, Portugal’s Umbrella Sky Project and Walk & Talk Biennale, Turkey’s Istanbul Theatre Festival and Biennial, and Greece’s Athens & Epidaurus Festival highlight the Med’s rich artistic tapestry.

programme.title: Med Institutions
programme.desc: Vanessa Macdonald sits down with representatives from COPEAM to explore how a network spanning the Mediterranean is bringing broadcasters, media professionals, universities and cultural organisations together. From encouraging collaboration to supporting young talent and celebrating the region’s shared cultures, the conversation looks at the power of media to create connections across borders. They also explore how the changing world of technology, including the opportunities and challenges that AI brings to journalism, broadcasting and the future of media.

programme.title: Makarska

programme.title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.sub-title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Sicily
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Sicily’s enchanting southeast, visiting Catania, Noto, Syracuse, and Ortigia. She dives into Catania’s lively fish market, samples local dishes like pasta alla norma and even horse meat burgers, and enjoys wine tasting in Noto’s vineyards. In Syracuse and Ortigia, she discovers stunning Greek ruins and seaside charm that showcase Sicily’s rich culture and history.

programme.title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.sub-title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.title: Split (Firule)
programme.desc: In Split’s Firule neighborhood—home to Croatia’s tennis greats—we discovered more than just sport. Renowned chef Hrvoje Zirojević welcomed us with a taste of tradition: pivac na tingul, a classic Dalmatian stew made with tender young rooster.

programme.title: Secret Garden Villa
programme.desc: Annette shows off a lovely detached house in the lovely village of Vigneta, which is only 20 minutes by car from Fivizzano. The upstairs is almost ready for people to move in right away, and the basement is a great place to do some renovations. Outside, you'll also find a beautiful, large garden that perfectly captures the spirit of Italian village life.

programme.title: Med Destinations Malta
programme.desc: Med Destinations uncovers the magic of Malta, an island rich in history, culture, and stunning coastal landscapes. From medieval streets to turquoise waters, Malta is a Mediterranean treasure.

programme.title: Med Destinations Pula
programme.desc: Discover Pula, Croatia, with Med Destinations. Famous for its Roman amphitheater and charming old town, Pula combines historical grandeur with Adriatic seaside beauty.

programme.title: Mediterranean Kitchen Italy
programme.desc: Chef Kurt welcomes Chef Fausto into the kitchen to learn the craft of a Roman icon: authentic Pasta all'Amatriciana, perfected with crispy guanciale and rich pecorino cheese. As they toss the pasta, the duo explores what makes Italian cooking so timeless: simplicity, incredible ingredients and great company.

programme.title: Whats On - 15 - Rhythms of the Mediterranean
programme.sub-title: Whats On - 15 - Rhythms of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: The Mediterranean dances to its own beat. Malta Muzika Muzika showcases national talent, while Italy Nameless Festival delivers international rock and electronic energy. Spain Azkena Rock Festival rocks Vitoria Gasteiz with legendary performances, and Turkey Istanbul Caz Festival blends jazz and local musical traditions. Discover how Mediterranean rhythms echo across genres, generations, and cultures.

programme.title: Night Time Metal
programme.desc: The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.

programme.title: Bay Area Godfathers II
programme.desc: Info not available

programme.title: For Metalheads Only
programme.desc: Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Finnish Metal Special
programme.desc: From the frozen North comes a sound of haunting melodies and raw intensity. Dive into Finland’s finest, where melancholic atmospheres meet the power of the thousand lakes. It’s a masterclass in darkness and ice-cold riffs.

programme.title: Folk Metal Forest Feast
programme.desc: Raise your horns and join the battle! A high-energy mix of crushing metal riffs, accordion melodies, and epic pagan chants. Step into the ancient woods for a wild night of acoustic tradition meets heavy metal fury.

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: Manic Ritual
programme.desc: Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

programme.title: Thrash Metal Attack
programme.desc: Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

programme.title: The Home of Heavy
programme.desc: Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

programme.title: Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

programme.title: Together We Rise
programme.desc: A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

programme.title: Death Metal Blasts Part 2
programme.desc: Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.desc: Britt heeft George omgetoverd tot Unicorn. Hij ziet er zo cool uit met zijn gekleurde manen en staart! Daarnaast laat Britt je zien hoe ze ervoor zorgt dat George altijd op zijn mooist voor de dag komt. Het is nog niet zo makkelijk om George wit te houden! Hopelijk gaat het haar lukken.

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest: De Grote Verhuisshow
programme.desc: Liveshow van Ernst en Bobbie. Ernst en Bobbie mogen verhuizen naar het kasteel! Reuze spannend natuurlijk. Ze pakken hun boeltje bij elkaar en vertrekken. Onderweg komen ze langs het circus en lopen daar de circusdirecteur tegen het lijf. Van schrik gaat Hendrika, de pratende papegaai, er vandoor. Eenmaal in het kasteel aangekomen moeten Ernst en Bobbie een kostbare schat bewaken. Maar wie is eigenlijk die vreemde postbode met de naam Bob Oef? En waar is Hendrika gebleven? Als dat maar goed gaat.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Paardenpraat TV: Op George rijden zonder hoofdstel en zadel
programme.desc: Britt vond het heerlijk om lekker zonder zadel op Vito te rijden. Op George heeft ze nog niet zo vaak zonder zadel gereden! Britt en George blijven oefenen om steeds beter te worden. Eerst gaat Britt oefenen met George zonder zadel en op muziek, om George te laten wennen. Vervolgens gaat ze op George zonder hoofdstel rijden. Als dat maar goed gaat!

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Paardenpraat TV: PaardenpraatTV Live
programme.desc: Kijk nu de Aftermovies van De PaardenpraatTV fandagen van 2019 en 2020. Het waren weer twee fantastische edities. Het was een geweldig weekend met geweldige shows, trouwe fans en gezellige meet and greets. Britt en Esra hebben stiekem nu al weer zin in de volgende editie.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Paardenpraat TV: Paarden naar de kapper
programme.desc: De manen van George en Halloween zijn weer erg lang geworden, dus het is tijd voor en knipbeurt. Ook Eve krijgt een nieuwe look. Ze wordt vandaag geschoren en Britt is benieuwd welke kleur nu tevoorschijn komt. Ze zijn helemaal klaar voor de make-over dag. Wat vinden jullie van de nieuwe looks?

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest: De Grote Verhuisshow
programme.desc: Liveshow van Ernst en Bobbie. Ernst en Bobbie mogen verhuizen naar het kasteel! Reuze spannend natuurlijk. Ze pakken hun boeltje bij elkaar en vertrekken. programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Vakantie
programme.desc: Naranjina zwaait de kadekapers uit: prettige vakantie, tot snel! Daarna gaat ze vrolijk terug naar binnen…

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Liefs van Ruben
programme.desc: Naranjina en de kadekapers rennen als gekken over de kade. Dokko rent achter ze aan. Vluchten ze voor Dokko? Nee, ze rennen achter een bankbiljet aan dat wappert op de wind. Uiteindelijk blijft het hoog in een kraan hangen. Naranjina baalt ervan: ze hebben al zo weinig verdiend vandaag.

programme.title: Cry Babies
programme.sub-title: S03 : E62 Cry Babies: De Jellies: Levende tranen
programme.desc: Het sap van de Tutti Frutti-baby’s is zo lekker dat de baby’s uit de Vallei huilen van geluk als ze ervan mogen proeven, maar deze keer zijn er niet de gebruikelijke magische tranen: het zijn Jellies!

programme.title: Cry Babies
programme.sub-title: S03 : E69 Cry Babies: Het Tutti Frutti-parfum
programme.desc: Grace maakt een nieuw parfum dat naar fruit ruikt. Ze doet een beetje van haar parfum op om het uit te proberen en als ze van huis weggaat zijn de andere Cry Babies Tutti Frutti in de ban van de geweldige geur…

programme.title: Cry Babies
programme.sub-title: S03 : E59 Cry Babies: Het Tutti Frutti-feestmaal
programme.desc: Angie en Nana zijn aan het koken als ze besluiten de Cry Babies Magic Tears van Fantasy-wereld en van de Vallei uit te nodigen voor een feestmaal in Tutti Frutti-baai. Zal het een leuke bijeenkomst worden voor alle Cry Babies?

programme.title: Cry Babies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Cry Babies: De grote verrassing
programme.desc: De langverwachte dag is eindelijk aangebroken! Alles is wit bedekt en de Cry Babies zijn er klaar voor om het huis en de boom te versieren, maar wacht ... iemand vergat de boom te kopen! Wat gaan ze doen?

programme.title: Hello Kitty
programme.desc: Als jij verdwaald bent, wie zou jij dan vertrouwen om de weg terug te vinden? De kinderen kunnen niet kiezen tussen Badtz-Maru en Daniël. Maar we mogen ook Pochacco niet vergeten, hij heeft namelijk een ‘neus’ voor dit soort dingen.

programme.title: Hello Kitty
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 Hello Kitty: De mars van de Badtz-Maru’s
programme.desc: Badtz-Maru gaat op een te gekke reis helemaal naar de Zuid pool! Onderweg komt hij achter de betekenis van echte vriendschap.

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest: De Verjaardag van Ernst
programme.desc: Liveshow van Ernst en Bobbie waarin de verjaardag van Ernst wordt gevierd. Alleen...zijn kado wordt gestolen!

programme.title: Hello Kitty
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Hello Kitty: Klein is fijn deel 1
programme.desc: Als jij maar een meter lang zou zijn, dan zou jij je wel klein voelen toch? Keroppi gebruikt zijn zelf bedachte dapperheid om boven de rest uit te komen ondanks zijn verticale uitdaging.

programme.title: Hello Kitty
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 Hello Kitty: Klein is fijn deel 2
programme.desc: In het twee deel van dit verhaal zitten Kitty en haar vrienden vast in een grot! Zij leren allemaal dat er ook voordelen zijn aan klein zijn.

programme.title: Dribbel
programme.desc: Dribbel wordt zo vroeg wakker dat mama en papa nog slapen. Dus Dribbel besluit om zijn eigen ontbijt te bereiden en maakt daarbij een hoop rommel!

programme.title: Dribbel
programme.sub-title: S03 : E30 Dribbel: Het paard van Dribbel
programme.desc: Dribbel, Helen en Steve hadden veel plezier door te doen alsof veel verschillende objecten in de tuin hun stokpaardjes zijn. Sally's bezem werkt het beste!

programme.title: Dribbel
programme.sub-title: S03 : E31 Dribbel: Dribbel en zijn opa
programme.desc: Opa komt op bezoek en neemt Dribbel mee naar het park, ze hebben zo'n spannende tijd dat opa in slaap valt voordat hij de kans heeft gehad om Dribbel zijn verhaaltje voor het slapengaan voor te lezen!

programme.title: Dribbel
programme.desc: Het regent en Dribbel wil bij Tom gaan spelen, gelukkig heeft hij zijn eigen paraplu om hem droog te houden. Dribbel ziet dat sommige dieren, zoals de eenden, van de regen houden, maar dat anderen, zoals de konijnen, er lang niet zo van houden.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Boes: Mama Ping loopt weg
programme.desc: Mama Ping is het zat om voor haar kinderen te zorgen. Ze wil graag een keer uitrusten en een dutje doen. Mama Ping loopt weg en laat papa Biton achter bij de kleintjes, maar papa kan het niet alleen aan en Boes probeert babysitters in te huren.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Boes: Boes vist maar net
programme.desc: Boes gaat vissen en verzamelt een regenworm. De regenworm wil liever niet door een vis worden opgeslokt en probeert te ontsnappen. Boes probeert hem te overtuigen, maar de regenworm wil niet luisteren.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Boes: Liefde doet pijn
programme.desc: Willy is verliefd op een vrouwelijke neushoorn. Hij heeft alleen wel een rivaal met een taaie en grote hoorn. Willy daagt zijn rivaal uit voor een duel, maar hij verliest het omdat zijn hoorn zo zacht is als een ballon. Boes heeft een idee!

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest: De Verjaardag van Ernst
programme.desc: Liveshow van Ernst en Bobbie waarin de verjaardag van Ernst wordt gevierd. Alleen...zijn kado wordt gestolen!

programme.title: Mouk

programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa denken terug aan hun avontuur in Canada, waar ze een uil redden die vastzit in een schuur.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa vertellen Popo en Mita over het kleurrijke Holi-feest dat ze meemaakten in India.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa denken terug aan hun avontuur op Kreta, waar ze Cassandra helpen om haar Xylofoon te maken, zodat ze kan optreden op het dorpsfestival.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa zijn op bezoek bij hun vriend Tucson in Utah. Zijn moeder toont hen hoe ze afdrukken maakt van oude voetsporen van dinosaurussen.

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij het Circus
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij het Circus: Kortsluiting
programme.desc: Er is vanavond een nachtvoorstelling in het circus. Alle lampen worden gecontroleerd. Als Bobbie per ongeluk zijn boemerang weggooit, komt deze in de elektriciteitskast terecht....kortsluiting! Lukt het Ernst en Bobbie om alles te regelen voordat de voorstelling start?

programme.title: De Prins van Oranje
programme.desc: Bestaan er prinsen die in sinaasappelen leven? En hoe redt de dappere prinses Aya haar sinaasappel-prins dan uit de handen van een reus? Of trouwt ze alsnog met een kwaadaardige kikker?

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij het Circus
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij het Circus: Lolo de Aap
programme.desc: Lolo de aap wil niet meer eten. De Circusdirecteur is ten einde raad. Zo kan de voorstelling niet doorgaan! Ernst en Bobbie gaan eens kijken bij de aap. Als Bobbie per ongeluk de deur open laat staan, ontsnapt de aap en kunnen Ernst en Bobbie zoeken. Als de Circusdirecteur het maar niet ziet!

programme.title: Koos & Moos
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Koos & Moos: Wat ishet WARM!
programme.desc: Moos is met ventilators en alle lichten aan een puzzel aan het maken. Koos legt met een dik aangekleed experiment uit dat al die energieverspilling de aarde nóg warmer maakt.

programme.desc: Ga samen met Hello Kitty en haar vrienden mee op een avontuur om het belang van het onderzoeken van de kleurrijke wereld te ontdekken.
